summary: Add a bounded current-authorized store projection of related person requests and retained exact source episodes

replay.detail: The read projection reuses retained canonical ask and lifecycle evidence without writing claims, changing replay authority, or propagating answers between requests.

schema.detail: Normal store index installation adds one partial expression index, claims_thread_history_link_index, over thread.ask-linked thread_id, ask, ask_episode, and link subject. It indexes existing references, not request payloads; there is no new claim kind, table, or storage-version transition.

rules.detail: Thread ownership and current exact-source assignee checks remain independent. Historical ownership is provenance, not read authority. Existing source writers, reply admission, Inbox discovery, unread state, and action authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: This change exposes a store/missions read seam only; existing client-v0, MCP, and generated client contracts are unchanged. Runtime asks and authored human steps use exact episode keys. Missing retained payload or unprovable historical status is explicit; current-authorized unsupported source kinds receive a marker instead of invented history rows. Scoped keyset cursors carry only the last visible exact key, reauthorize every page, and read status fresh; newly appearing keys before the anchor require a refresh.

downtime.detail: No deployment or writer cutover is introduced by the read seam. Existing databases receive the additive reference index through normal schema index installation.

manual.detail: The link index's producer is fractal_store::store::thread_metadata. Its keys are existing thread IDs, exact ask episode references, and deterministic ask-link subjects. Ordered keyset seeks stream links after the page anchor and use shared canonical membership/current authorization before visible lookahead; cost includes denied or losing operation rows between anchors, never a UNION materialization of all thread links. The retained readers bound decoded bodies and lifecycle inputs and never snapshot referenced documents or PRs. Reconcile reviewed SQL sites, source fingerprints, and index declarations through scripts/propose-sqlite-large-values and the established inventory review on the Mac venue; inventory regeneration/freshness is not claimed by this change.

recovery.detail: The projection retains no new historical data and grants no mutation authority. Missing evidence stays unavailable rather than substituting current text; existing runtime recovery procedures are unchanged.
